verdict.reasons: The single commercial product is the correct white-and-blue upright AFP drip-tape carton roll, with legible and consistent branding. The installed flat coiled line is contextually consistent with drip tape; no additional commercial product or substituted plumbing is present. The required watermark is present and correct, and the scene matches the agronomy topic. The metallic stake-like foreground object and the small coil around individual seedlings are minor technical evidence imperfections, not core defects. Overall quality and identity remain well above the minimum threshold.

No black irrigation line touches or crosses the base of the white and blue AFP package. There is an extra loose product coil, which is the coiled black drip tape sitting on the dirt next to the box. The package has a protruding strip, evidenced by the long white plastic tool-like object lying flat on the soil in front of the carton, visually emerging from the base area.
